vc_checking.summary: Seven of the eight current manual witnesses have complete semantic proof routes, but proof_of_xizi_single_link_remove_node_return_wit_1 is not entailed by its generated precondition. The loop invariant carries the current addresses linklist and linklist_node in its spatial resources, while the strong postcondition requires the snapshot addresses linklist_pre and linklist_node_pre; no premise equates either pair. A concrete satisfiable instance makes linklist distinct from linklist_pre and linklist_node distinct from linklist_node_pre, so both postcondition disjuncts are false. This is an annotation-level missing-alias bug, not a group-local helper gap, and the round must return to annotation before proof groups are scheduled.

witnesses.failure_signal: Concrete counterexample shape: take l1_strong_spec = l2_strong_spec = l0 = l1a = l1b = nil; choose distinct aligned addresses linklist_pre = 16, linklist_node_pre = 32, linklist = node = 48, and linklist_node = next = 64; set both successor values to 0 and l_strong_spec = [32]. All listed pure premises hold. The spatial antecedent reduces to disjoint cells 48.node_next |-> 0 and 64.node_next |-> 0 (with empty segment/to-target/suffix predicates), so it is satisfiable. Both conclusions are false because they require 48 = 16 and ownership rooted at addresses 16 and 32.
